---
The bar is subterranean, Peter. It's common knowledge in WA-03 that incumbent Rep. Jaime Herrera Beutler doesn't care about her constituents. If you're in the district, you know the ongoing, no-so-funny joke that perhaps Jaime would care more about us if we were salmon. Maybe that's why white nationalist, Trump-endorsed Joe Kent is gaining ground on Herrera Beutler, despite his deplorable views. Tim Miller, of the right-leaning publication _The Bulwark_ , has been following Joe Kent's campaign. Just last week, Kent went groveling on a radio program run by white nationalist teenagers, expressing his support of racial quotas in immigration policy and other reprehensible views. Here's just a tiny sampling of what Kent had to say: _" I don't think there's anything wrong with there being a white-people special interest group. They have to be very careful about the way they couch that and the way they frame that, obviously in terms of messaging and in terms of getting credibility. I don't think there's anything wrong with that. As far as me running as a candidate, running out there and saying this is all about white people, that does not seem like a winning strategy."_ _- Joe Kent _ Kent is okay with these reprehensible ideas, he just knows he can't run on them as a candidate! But he's gaining ground on the incumbent, who broke with the GOP and voted to impeach Trump. In other words, she's not extreme enough for today's Republican party. **I 'm ahead of both of them in the polls right now, and we must take advantage of the split in the GOP candidates. # Outrage Over Survival Food
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjjqniefdp0dtm0rfark41l9j711dsj6109j9nd8_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs) According to leading industry sources, grocery stores across the United States are worried about food shortages. Experts say more grocery hoarding may come as disruptions push America's food supply "near its breaking point". **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to be hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means your family can become malnourished...

Well, I decided not to worry anymore. Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by most stores. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of the best-selling [**4Patriots Survival Food Kits**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvvf68dv34fr7mmr3jgo2uf7ka1d4k435p7io6u0_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs). Currently 4Patriots survival food kits are flying off the shelves because:
* **4Patriots Survival Food Kits are a tremendous value.** This is _not_ ordinary food. This is delicious, nutritious, good-for-25-years super survival food that protects you from going hungry in a crisis. This is high quality survival food without any fillers or poor-quality "frankenfood" that the other guys use to pad their survival meals. They are made right in the U.S.A. and you won't believe how inexpensive these kits are - just a **fraction of what some other brands charge**.
* There's no fancy packaging, it's military-grade sturdy stuff and can stand up to the crazy things that happen in a crisis. This food has a **shelf life of up to 25 years** , so you have complete peace of mind for the long term. And they're using the most compact kits so you can store them anywhere in your house without any extra hassle. They're sturdy, water-resistant and stack easily. And extremely covert too.
* You can make these meals in less than 20 minutes. Just add boiling water, simmer, and serve. I tried 'em and I think they **taste as good or better than any other survival food I 've ever had**. And you get a whole slew of choices for breakfast, lunch and dinner so you don't get stuck eating the same thing day-in and day-out.

That's extra meals (on the house), grab-and-go portability and a way to get through any short-term crisis without even breaking into your stash. **People love these kits.** It's one of their top-rated items on our website. So you'll get those 2 complimentary 72-hour Survival Food Kits AND... _(Hold on to your hat, folks)_ **FREE Bonus #2:** They're also going to give you their **Victory Garden Seed Collection.** Each Victory Garden Seed Collection contains survival seeds from 8 varieties of garden favorites. You'll harvest them again and again, season after season. It's like having a mini-microwave the size of a thermos. **FREE Bonus #4:** They're also going to give you their **Exclusive Ultimate Survival Digital Library.** With these 4 digital books you'll have the information and tips to help you prepare for an emergency. Normally valued at $19.95, you'll get this brand NEW report for FREE. **FREE Bonus #6:** You also get **Freedom Joe 's Survival Coffee.** Rich, aromatic coffee designed to last 25 years. You get 30 servings of delicious, aromatic survival coffee added to your Kit. **FREE Bonus #7:** You also get **Bugle Boy Survival Cocoa.** Warm up with each cup of chocolatey goodness that is sure to satisfy the young and the young at heart. With your Survival Cocoa Kits, you'll have the satisfying comfort of a steaming cup of cocoa when you and your loved ones need it most. But we're still not done because you also get... **FREE Bonus #8:** You also get **$25 OFF Your Next Purchase.** This is FREE money in the bank for you. You get $25 off any future purchase of $100 or more. Use it to get our best-selling survival food, solar gadgets and so much more! Get whatever you need to round out your preparedness plan. It's completely up to you. That's what we call an incredible deal. But we want to sweeten the pot more. It's not cheap to ship 688 servings of food in two totes (plus all the FREE gifts you're getting). But you deserve it for becoming a loyal customer. And frankly, we want to do it for you. **[Grab Your Kit And All Your Gifts Today Before They're All Gone](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdatlfkmdkm0ivsssf4no3kpohll5vkl8errsa0o_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs)** Isn't that great? The best part is... The peace of mind that comes from having a survival food stockpile shouldn't exclusively be for well-off Americans. [**So you 're getting huge savings today.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0vo3c2kipmqadgob6k8s21vn9tb6ir6ao1mk43g_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs) **You 'll even get an easy, no nonsense monthly payment plan.** Just the best-tasting, made-in-America survival food protection without the sticker shock. **Look, this food tastes homemade.** It's built to last the long haul. It's a snap to prepare. And everyone from former Navy SEALs to middle-American grandmas are singing its praises. Second, if you open your 4Patriots meals anytime in the next 25 years and find your food has spoiled or gone bad, you can return the entire stockpile and they will still **return triple your purchase amount.** That's how confident they are that this food will stay delicious and nutritious for the next 25 years. **[Grab Your Kit And All Your Gifts Today Before They're All Gone](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7g32e5ugas6m5akjrhr6208mtdil5v49paddt98_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs)** You need to get 'er done today. Why? Because if you don't [take action](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd6rpdn8c05cc05gfoeb7tdfbo6jps61lbb6nmug_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs) to get your food stockpile today, you'll be in the same boat as the brainwashed masses who think "everything is fine." And if a crisis hits and your family asks, "What are we going to eat?" your mouth will go dry and you'll feel powerless. But what if you decide to secure your food stockpile instead? Just [imagine how much better you'll feel right away](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z426d0gajtpcj9kcajbk1eevls8fab7qpebb25g8_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs). When a crisis hits, you will be able to calmly reassure them that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. Listen, I can't predict the future. I don't know exactly when or how a crisis will hit. **As it stands today, it 's every man for himself.** In a crisis, the loss will be beyond what you can imagine. That's why I want you to have the same peace of mind that I do. **[Grab Your Kit And All Your Gifts Today Before They're All Gone](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg01kkk4a9kfpd6032s9fee7v4j7faksscpklcng_rp22sh2s8i66ob7cpj69pj7cth2bs)** To your survival,

Frank Bates

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c25464%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6014sU13xp6mD0Dlct4YEg&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

body:
[](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) Last week President Trump said that eliminating Critical Race Theory (CRT) from schools "is a matter of national survival." He's absolutely right. That's why over the last year I've launched the nation's largest and most effective anti-CRT organization. My team and I target local school board races all over the country to get rid of radical CRT-pushing leftists with SANE America-loving people like you and I. **[But, there's no way we can eliminate CRT from our schools without your help. Would you consider making a generous donation of ANY amount to help me put an end to Critical Race Theory?](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC)** Peter, I've seen what's happening in our schools -- on our dimes, and I'm sure you have too. Public schools all over the country are relentlessly pushing Critical Race Theory, and convincing America's children that they need to change their sexual preferences and gender identities. _[**It's state-sanctioned leftist indoctrination, plain and simple.**](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC)_** ** As I discussed on **_Tucker Carlson Tonight_** , I get rid of the people who are indoctrinating our children by replacing them with SANE conservative Americans. For decades, shady dark-money billionaires like **_George Soros_** have funneled massive amounts of cash into the pockets of radical left-wing activists to take up government positions in communities all over the country. **[One of Soros's favorite targets is local school board races](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC).** _And I hate to break it to you, but his plan has been wildly successful. _ Right now, in EVERY STATE IN AMERICA (including the red states), teachers are indoctrinating our students with CRT. If you're not familiar with CRT, it's the doctrine that all white people are oppressors, and that your skin color determines everything about you. Beyond this, _CRT teaches kids that America is evil to its core, and that everything that makes our country great, is secretly racist._** ** **_Then, what's worse is that these radical school boards allow, hire, and encourage teachers who have been caught ACTIVELY recruiting children to become transgender._** And Peter, you may not have seen it happening at the time, but for too long Republicans have neglected local races and instead focused on "BIG" races for President, Governor, and Congress. But in the process, we've left room for people like George Soros to take over local governments all over the country, right under our noses. Now, with all this doom and gloom, it's easy to feel defeated. **But I have a plan to take back our schools from the radical left and put an end to critical race theory...** And I know that, with your support, it'll work. And if you don't want to take my word for it... Just read what Tucker Carlson said: **["Parents have almost no support, _but now they do_. The _1776 Project PAC_ __ is a political action committee designed to help school boards and communities elect sane people.... If you're thinking of writing a check... Think of writing it to Ryan Girdusky." ](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC)** [**HELP US TAKE BACK OUR SCHOOLS TODAY!**](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) Let me introduce myself. [**My name is Ryan Girdusky, and I founded the 1776 Project PAC ensure that Critical Race Theory is eradicated from our schools.**](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) **_And I have the 3 R's Battle Plan to do just that!_** **_Resign:_** we'll turn up the public pressure with TV, Radio, and Print media campaigns calling for far left school board members to quit. **_Recall:_** we'll help collect petitions signatures and aid local parents, grandparents, and concerned taxpayers in efforts to recall radical school board members who must be removed from office. **_Replace:_** We'll support the campaigns of pro-America conservatives who run for local school board against liberal pro-CRT school board members. In the coming year, we are hoping to triple our impact! [**But, Peter, we can't roll out this plan without your support. Will you rush in $17.76 to the 1776 Project PAC as we prepared to target more than 300 races this year??**](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) Now, I'm guessing you've never heard of me before... **....But, I'd be willing to bet you've heard Tucker, Laura Ingraham, and Donald Trump Jr. ** I've had the chance to discuss my plan with them, and they all believe that _the 1776 Project PAC's 3 R's Campaign Battle Plan is a game-changer!_ Here's what each of them said: **> >>> Tucker Carlson: "**Parents have almost no support, _but now they do_. The **_1776 Project PAC_** __ is a political action committee designed to help school boards and communities elect sane people.... If you're thinking of writing a check... Think of writing it to Ryan Girdusky." **> >>> Laura Ingraham: **"For all the parents out there looking to reclaim your local school boards from radical leftists, help is on the way, a new political action committee called the **_1776 Project_** is going to support school board candidates who oppose indoctrinating kids with things like Critical Race Theory." **> >>> Donald Trump Jr.: **"The **_1776 Project_** is the very first Political Action Committee of it's kind, specifically created to take on this sinister attack on our way of life from within our own communities by working to take local schools boards out of the hands of these America-hating radical liberals..." Even the failing and biased New York Times admitted that we _" lit a fire"_ that is only growing as more conservative patriots like you join the fight in supporting the 1776 Project PAC.** ** **But here is the best part. The 1776 Project PAC has only been around for a year, and we already have a track-record of success. ** In November of 2021, we flipped 44 seats. In the coming year, as long as we have your help, we are set to more than TRIPLE our impact. Here's an amazing statistic that I'd like to share with you... It cost the 1776 Project PAC an average of $3,000 per WIN last year. _That means that every PENNY matters, and your donation of $17.76 could be the deciding factor in whether or not 1,000s of children of subjected to Critical Race Theory. _ **After 30 years of left-wing billionaires like George Soros flooding cash into local school board races, we finally have a way to fight back with the 1776 Project PAC.** [**Please consider helping us fight back against George Soros and the radical socialist left in our school boards with a generous contribution of $17.76, $25, $50, or $100.**](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) President Trump said it best: The fate of our nation depends on of our people's willingness to lay down their lives to defend their lives. Peter, he's absolutely right. Ending Critical Race Theory in our schools is a matter of national survival. Thank you in advance for fighting alongside President Trump and I to put an end to CRT. Sincerely, [](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) Ryan Girdusky P.S. I know you may not know anything about me, but I hope that the endorsements from incredible conservative leaders like my friends Tucker, Laura, and Donald Trump Jr. give you confidence in my dedication to the mission of taking school boards back from radical liberals. [**Will you invest in the future of our country by making a generous contribution to the 1776 Project PAC as we fight to Resign, Recall, or Replace far-left indoctrinators?**](
https://secure.anedot.com/1776-project-pac-99d14578-8f5f-4ad9-9c0d-027a6f70529f/c428a1abd75e6709ac9f1?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_1776_PTE_REV_SMC-SMC) [**DONATE NOW**](

| | |

Late last week, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi dropped at [2,700-page Omnibus Spending Bill](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001J-Hz3hUjYsStRl31bfS7F40QUossQX8ITsJ3m42jjND8Qq1duB6HqNMZ0XhS8vlwqGCbuDqij6xvYQ0FdcwWugRNaK46XAjNbASuot5NReLXbz5of4c3cyo5w2A7H-pBmcjHY-pDsOib-_rs6VY9DH1M_-0XhFmD&c=sCXm_PeEydP_8WsXRGtSw4dZ8D88vbicHitxutt1ndlxS826UiRpCQ==&ch=6_bN70coiGSsPj4TZbKyJJUF59MhNktmshz2VMmpHGbt6z3fsS6zVw==) filled with all types of financial goodies for the political insiders and special interest groups, and anti-gun legislation in the middle of the night (1:30 AM to be exact). Within 48 hours BOTH the House and the Senate passed a bill they hadn't even read. In an election year where he represents the most conservative Congressional District in Washington State, you'll never guess how Congressman Newhouse voted: He was 1 of only 39 Republicans to vote Yes on a bill he hadn't even read and support Pelosi and the Democrat gun grab efforts (in addition to spending $1.5 Trillion of money we don't have. And you and I will be the one to pay for it). I believe he's lost his mind. That or he is simply planning to retire and not run for re-election.

Our friends at the [Gun Owners of America](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001J-Hz3hUjYsStRl31bfS7F40QUossQX8ITsJ3m42jjND8Qq1duB6HqNMZ0XhS8vlwYRp-6uDd3ifFQZelmF8LSdud9rMUKy2Kx0flxaoRUD4RuAFjt3qPa6oTUqqDx4r2mra4a7vei0xG2UdPulJVqE7wzxGva_2FRsH0BV2SHVs=&c=sCXm_PeEydP_8WsXRGtSw4dZ8D88vbicHitxutt1ndlxS826UiRpCQ==&ch=6_bN70coiGSsPj4TZbKyJJUF59MhNktmshz2VMmpHGbt6z3fsS6zVw==) have led the charge against this terrible legislation. On Wednesday at 1:30 AM, the House of Representatives dropped a 2,700+ page, $1.5+ trillion spending bill containing the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization Act (VAWA) and the NICS Denial Notification Act--both of which included gun control. In Washington State, two of the three Republican members of Congress voted with the Democrats. Only Representative McMorris-Rogers voted to protect gun rights; Representative Newhouse and Beutler voted with Nasty Nancy Pelosi.

Most Republicans stood tall against this bill: 171 House Republicans voted 'No', while 39 House Republicans voted with Nancy Pelosi. 31 Senate Republicans voted 'No', while 18 Republican Senators voted with Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden.

Today marks an important anniversary in the history of the fight for voting rights, friend.

57 years ago, on March 15, 1965, President Johnson addressed the joint session of Congress and called for passage of the **Voting Rights Act.**

This was _8 days_ after the unprovoked assault on voting rights activists on the **Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma, Alabama — now known as Bloody Sunday.**

Months later, the Voting Rights Act was finally signed into law on August 6, 1965.

This bill has become _fundamental_ in preventing racial discrimination in voting, including the banning of literacy tests and ensuring there are no barriers to exercising our rights to vote.

Since then, Congress has expanded the act five times to increase its protections. But now, as we see Republicans trying to pass restrictive and discriminatory voting laws in state legislatures across the country, including right here in Pennsylvania, we must act to preserve and expand its protections again.

**[This is why I voted multiple times to pass voting rights legislation in the House, and I promise to continue to vote in the interest of _all_ our voters in the Senate. | | Peter,

This campaign has created a groundswell movement, talking about the issues that matter to ALL Minnesotans: safety in our streets, students prioritized over broken institutions, SCIENCE (not political science) leading our decision making, and ensuring our elections are SECURE.

We need you to get on board. With the announcement of Minnesota Vikings Legend Matt Birk joining our team as my Lt. Governor, the far-left machine is moving in full force against us. This is a generational movement, in an effort to replace failed leadership. Will you [help build this grassroots war chest](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=df4427413c&e=33b11688c1) and defeat Tim Walz?
* [Give $5 to help us boost a social media post](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=55684ea2ce&e=33b11688c1)
* [Give $25 to help us send a statewide mailer](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=d3383f1985&e=33b11688c1)
* [Give $50 to help us hold a campaign rally](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=5ede368255&e=33b11688c1)
* [Give $150 to help us buy statewide radio ads](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=a782a33632&e=33b11688c1)
* [Give $250 or more to help us buy television ads](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=0aeee63858&e=33b11688c1)

---
| I’ve seen firsthand the crushing fist of the far-left. I went from Family Doctor of the year in 2016 to the most investigated Doctor in America in 2020. Why? Because I spoke truth to power against the COVID lockdowns, vaccine mandates, and overreaching government! Big pharma and big tech didn’t like that. They tried to take my medical license 5 times and I beat them. I continue to be a tireless, relentless fighter for our constitution and our God-given rights. My patients trust me to be their advocate, and now I’m asking to be YOUR advocate as Governor. [Will you help this winning campaign get across the finish line?](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=55d8615c94&e=33b11688c1)

Whether it’s fighting for health freedom, the rights of the unborn, the 2nd Amendment, safety in our streets, reforming our broken education system, or creating a better economy, I am the candidate who has STOOD IN THE BREACH and not blinked. I’ve grown up here in Minnesota, I’ve seen the challenges, I’ve stood strong because that’s what Minnesotans do. The spirit of Minnesota is still strong, but we need new leadership. [Let's WIN](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=cb7c137dfd&e=33b11688c1) and LEAD again in Minnesota.

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor
Minnesota

subject: The GOP’s plan for 2022 is disastrous

body:
Senate Republicans have obstructed and tried to tear down our agenda. Instead of working on behalf of families and workers, Mitch McConnell’s GOP is catering to corporations and the wealthy.
#
Peter,
Every day in the other Washington, I’ve been fighting for legislation that is going to give families some breathing room and help our economy continue to come back strong. And a big part of that is lower essential costs. I’m already working in the Senate to do that with legislation that lowers families’ health care and child care costs, creates good-paying jobs, and more.
But at every step, Senate Republicans have obstructed and tried to tear down our agenda. Instead of working on behalf of families and workers, Mitch McConnell’s GOP is catering to corporations and the wealthy. We can’t afford to lose a single seat this November – in fact, to build on our progress from 2021, we must _**expand**_ our Senate majority.
**[We set our March mid-month fundraising goal with that objective in mind: expanding our majority and building on our progress for working families. Will you chip in $5 to help make it a reality?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42990932/335224161/2004369102?refcode=pm_em_220315_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OGQwN2I3Mi03OWE0LWVjMTEtYTIyYS0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X4Dt3RD0_bUqcfwcjU52qvLM7y5ycvPQdat82_0blig=)**
Here at home, Republicans are feeling encouraged about how they’re polling–and ultra right news outlets like Fox News are taking notice. This is making Republicans start to feel confident enough to target this seat and others in Washington state.
And as time passes, the Senate GOP’s agenda for 2022 is becoming clearer. Just in the past weeks, Republicans have made two major campaign promises: raising taxes on workers and retirees and repealing Obamacare. Not only have Republicans refused to come to the table to help _lower_ costs, now they’re promising to _raise_ them.
I refuse to back down and allow Republicans to raise taxes and health care costs for families. **And I need you on this team with me, Peter.**
**[Let’s send the Republicans a message: Washington state won’t stand for politicians who put big corporations ahead of working families and communities. Rush in $5 now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42990933/335224162/2004369102?refcode=pm_em_220315_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OGQwN2I3Mi03OWE0LWVjMTEtYTIyYS0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X4Dt3RD0_bUqcfwcjU52qvLM7y5ycvPQdat82_0blig=)**

Patty

subject: Voters Deserve Answers from Lisa Scheller on China
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kevin Dellicker for Congress
body:
New report raises troubling questions about her conflicts of interest | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/dellickerforcongress/ask-lisa-scheller?e=1090c5c412)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Voters,

Since late January, I've been asking Lisa Scheller to have a debate. Now its mid-March, and my Republican primary opponent still hasn't met me on the public stage. Perhaps now we know why.

A recent article in _[The CEO Magazine](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=7b12f7394c&e=1090c5c412) _details Lisa Scheller's new investments in China. It includes the following revelations about Silberline Manufacturing, which is privately owned by Lisa Scheller, who also serves as the company's Global Chairman and President:

**Lisa Scheller's company is opening a new factory in China next year. **“It will become one of our global production centres and comprise state-of-the-art technology,” said Silberline’s Managing Director Asia-Pacific.

**Lisa Scheller's company is investing in China’s public infrastructure. **The same source said that Silberline, “helped the government build roads in China.” Here's a link to the original [article](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=2c48ac8395&e=1090c5c412).

**Lisa Scheller's company is partnering with China's state-owned metals conglomerate. **Silberline’s Managing Director Asia-Pacific revealed a strategic partnership with Angang Group Aluminum, a division of Ansteel Group, which is controlled by the Chinese Communist Party.

Most people have no idea about Lisa Scheller's deep ties to China, and voters are often surprised when they learn the details. According to her most recent [financial disclosure report](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=01fbff6b8b&e=1090c5c412), Lisa Scheller earned between $1.2 million and $7 million from her operations in China over the past two years, which is between 33% to 95% of her total reported business income. This isn't a minor stake from years ago. It's a major investment right now.

I've been warning people about the threat from the Chinese Communist Party and the refusal of our nation's elites to take them seriously. In a series of [blog posts](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=d54585ec4b&e=1090c5c412), I've detailed the atrocities that communist leaders are inflicting upon the Chinese people, their neighbors, and American families. And I've proposed a [38-point plan](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=79967b7d39&e=1090c5c412) to counter Chinese aggression before they become a superpower adversary or lash out like Russia.

But let's be clear: we can't counter Chinese communists if Members of Congress are partnering with them in business.

_The CEO Magazine_ report raises serious allegations, and Lisa Scheller deserves the chance to respond. Perhaps the article is incorrect? Perhaps there's another Angang Group that isn't run by communists? With the election just nine weeks away, the voters need answers now.

I've prepared a printable [Fact Sheet](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=76a9a605f1&e=1090c5c412) and a website with everything in one place: www.AskLisaScheller.com ([click here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=e96b73f54a&e=1090c5c412)). My sources are carefully documented for public scrutiny. Please review these materials and make up your own minds. Here is what I think:

**No Member of Congress should cast votes in Washington while cutting ribbons in China**.

If Lisa Scheller were to win the election, she would have a conflict of interest between protecting her Chinese investments and representing her American constituents. She must immediately address these reports, disclose her relationships with China, and detail any partnership her company has with communist-affiliated organizations.

The voters are waiting.

Sincerely,

Kevin Dellicker

body:
If you've seen me on conservative news shows, or are familiar with my work at TownHall or PJ Media, you know I don't apologize for my conservative values, and I'll defend my constitutional rights to the hilt. I'm proud of America... **NOT ASHAMED!** **And, I know since you are reading this, that you aren't ashamed of America or our values either.** **But there are millions of young people who aren't provided with the truth about your conservative ideas... ** [**Will you help give these young people the opportunity to hear your conservative ideas?**](
https://yaf.revv.co/017b51fa0af78df4?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_YAF_KPP3_REV_SMC-SMC) It's easy to see why young people are impressionable to liberal indoctrination. They're high school and college students in schools where free speech is under constant assault and where political correctness and socialism is pushed in the classroom. Liberals bully students showing interest in your conservative ideas. I should know, just ten years ago I was a young, impressionable student at the University of Arizona. **It didn't take me long to realize that my teachers didn't just dislike the conservative values my parents had instilled in me...****_they hated them._** My professors relied on MSNBC and CNN as the "gold standard" when it came to presenting the "truth" in their classes. But I had no idea they'd try to silence my voice until I got involved with a national conservative organization called **Young America's Foundation (YAF).** With YAF's support and access to their campus lecture program, I decided to invite conservative author and activist **David Horowitz** to speak on our campus. He had just written a book about "how radical professors at America's top colleges indoctrinate students and undermine our democracy. " And I was just about to discover just how right he was. Just two days before the lecture, the school threatened to shut David Horowitz's lecture down unless our campus group coughed up cash to pay for "security" because administrators had deemed the lecture "controversial." Meanwhile, leftist activists tore down our signs and posters advertising the event so students wouldn't know about it. Then, just three hours before the start of the event, the school moved the lecture to a hidden-away classroom in the hopes that no one would show up. Yet, despite every roadblock they threw at us, **the event was a HUGE success.** University of Arizona students got to hear David Horowitz explain why free enterprise and conservatism are the true roots of freedom. **And I learned a valuable lesson: ** **The Left will do anything to prevent young people from hearing conservatives because they know that students who hear the truth about our values will reject socialism.** Oh, you won't hear much about the threats, violence, and intimidation pointed at conservatives in schools from the mainstream media. But I've witnessed it firsthand. [**And despite the fear and intimidation tactics these radical leftists use in schools, I want you to know YOU can play a pivotal part to ensure more young Americans hear the truth about our conservative values by joining YAF today.**** **](
https://yaf.revv.co/017b51fa0af78df4?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_YAF_KPP3_REV_SMC-SMC) **You see, YAF had such an impact on my life that today I'm one of their speakers.** And I personally know how enraged the Left can get when we speak up for commonsense values that used to be taken for granted, such as border security, free enterprise, and traditional family values. For example:
* When I spoke at the university of Wisconsin, radical campus activists protested my speech by committing an obscene act that should have been treated as sexual harassment. Instead, the university ignored protestors, labeled me as "controversial" and imposed a "security fee" on the local YAF chapter.
* And later, at Kennesaw State University in Georgia, campus administrators tried to prevent me from speaking. They claimed I was "controversial," and campus administrators tried to force the local YAF chapter to pay a heavy handed "security fee" in a clear effort to stifle free speech.

But I'm not the only YAF speaker who's had to deal with this kind of intimidation. Many other YAF speakers have been disrupted... **and even seriously endangered.** **Ben Shapiro was threatened by a violent Antifa terrorist demonstration, after U.C. Berkeley was forced to allow him to speak after a lawsuit filed by YAF.** The First Amendment says every American deserves to have their voice heard in the public square. Everyone deserves a chance to share their opinion and defend their viewpoints. **_But the Left is terrified of your ideas._** That's why the Left seeks to SILENCE our voices, instead of debating us. I've heard many good people say it's too late, there's nothing we can do to stop the Left from indoctrinating young people on college campuses with socialism. **_But it's simply not true, YAF is living proof we CAN stop them. _** Time and time again, **_YAF has sued campuses who sought to censor conservative speakers and WON_** , ensuring young Americans can hear our shared conservative values and ideas. **Let's face it, with the far Left firmly in control of our public school system and most colleges, young Americans won't hear these basic truths unless YAF is there to tell them** And time is running out for us to fight the lifetime of indoctrination forced upon our college age students. **[If you want to help recruit the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement, I hope you will make a tax-deductible gift to Young America's Foundation today.](
https://yaf.revv.co/017b51fa0af78df4?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220314_BDG_YAF_KPP3_REV_SMC-SMC)** Remember, the Left is determined to silence voices like ours in schools across the country. In fact, they tried their best to stop YAF... _Your support of YAF is so important because without your help, they'll succeed and your conservative values WILL BE SILENCED._ **This is simply not a battle we can afford to lose.** We must decide whether our country remains a bastion of freedom or it will be twisted and transformed into a socialist dystopia. The next generation is the key in ensuring that our nation doesn't make the wrong choice. Thank you in advance for you support of this crucial mission. Gratefully, **K atie Pavlich ** _Fox News Contributor_ _New York Times Bestselling Author_ _Editor, Townhall.com_ _Young __America's Foundation Speaker_ [**DONATE**](

I'm proud of America... NOT ASHAMED! And, I know since you are reading this, that you aren't ashamed of America or our values either. But there are millions of young people who aren't provided with the truth about your conservative ideas... It's easy to see why young people are impressionable to liberal indoctrination. They're high school and college students in schools where free speech is under constant assault and where political correctness and socialism is pushed in the classroom. Liberals bully students showing interest in your conservative ideas. I should know, just ten years ago I was a young, impressionable student at the University of Arizona. It didn't take me long to realize that my teachers didn't just dislike the conservative values my parents had instilled in me...they hated them. My professors relied on MSNBC and CNN as the "gold standard" when it came to presenting the "truth" in their classes. But I had no idea they'd try to silence my voice until I got involved with a national conservative organization called Young America's Foundation (YAF). With YAF's support and access to their campus lecture program, I decided to invite conservative author and activist David Horowitz to speak on our campus. He had just written a book about "how radical professors at America's top colleges indoctrinate students and undermine our democracy. " And I was just about to discover just how right he was. Just two days before the lecture, the school threatened to shut David Horowitz's lecture down unless our campus group coughed up cash to pay for "security" because administrators had deemed the lecture "controversial." Meanwhile, leftist activists tore down our signs and posters advertising the event so students wouldn't know about it. Then, just three hours before the start of the event, the school moved the lecture to a hidden-away classroom in the hopes that no one would show up. Yet, despite every roadblock they threw at us, the event was a HUGE success. University of Arizona students got to hear David Horowitz explain why free enterprise and conservatism are the true roots of freedom. And I learned a valuable lesson: The Left will do anything to prevent young people from hearing conservatives because they know that students who hear the truth about our values will reject socialism. Oh, you won't hear much about the threats, violence, and intimidation pointed at conservatives in schools from the mainstream media. But I've witnessed it firsthand. You see, YAF had such an impact on my life that today I'm one of their speakers. And I personally know how enraged the Left can get when we speak up for commonsense values that used to be taken for granted, such as border security, free enterprise, and traditional family values. For example: When I spoke at the university of Wisconsin, radical campus activists protested my speech by committing an obscene act that should have been treated as sexual harassment. Instead, the university ignored protestors, labeled me as "controversial" and imposed a "security fee" on the local YAF chapter. And later, at Kennesaw State University in Georgia, campus administrators tried to prevent me from speaking. They claimed I was "controversial," and campus administrators tried to force the local YAF chapter to pay a heavy handed "security fee" in a clear effort to stifle free speech. But I'm not the only YAF speaker who's had to deal with this kind of intimidation. Many other YAF speakers have been disrupted... and even seriously endangered. Ben Shapiro was threatened by a violent Antifa terrorist demonstration, after U.C. Berkeley was forced to allow him to speak after a lawsuit filed by YAF. The First Amendment says every American deserves to have their voice heard in the public square. Everyone deserves a chance to share their opinion and defend their viewpoints. But the Left is terrified of your ideas. That's why the Left seeks to SILENCE our voices, instead of debating us. I've heard many good people say it's too late, there's nothing we can do to stop the Left from indoctrinating young people on college campuses with socialism. But it's simply not true, YAF is living proof we CAN stop them. Time and time again, YAF has sued campuses who sought to censor conservative speakers and WON , ensuring young Americans can hear our shared conservative values and ideas. Let's face it, with the far Left firmly in control of our public school system and most colleges, young Americans won't hear these basic truths unless YAF is there to tell them And time is running out for us to fight the lifetime of indoctrination forced upon our college age students. I know you’re busy, but I wanted to reach out because as a mother and a U.S. citizen, I am worried about what we’re seeing in our nation.

My parents and I lived during the dark times of the communist Soviet Union. I remember all the restrictions that were imposed on my family and all the liberties that were taken away from us.

Despite being so young, I remember those days, and I remember when my parents decided to take me and my sister to America – **the land of opportunity.**

My parents’ brave decision to leave everything behind and pursue the American Dream, allowed me to become a nurse and a mother of two wonderful boys in the land of the free.

However, I am truly worried that the dark times my parents escaped from, is the same thing that is slowly coming back again!

**As Ronald Reagan once said,** __**“If we lose freedom here, there is no place to escape to. This is the last stand on Earth.”**__

**He wasn’t wrong,** that’s why so much of what we’re seeing these days has me worried.

I am worried that career politicians want power and not our best interest.

I am worried that many cities support crime as it benefits them politically.

I am worried that some cities and states are allowing illegal immigrants to vote.

I am worried that inflation is robbing our savings.

I am worried that people and their livelihoods are being replaced by robots.

I am worried that Iran will gain nuclear weapons and threaten us all.

I am worried that politicians want to control our children’s education.

I am worried that our children are being mandated to get vaccines.

I am worried that our traditional values are vanishing!

_**I am worried that we are experiencing the death of the American Dream.**_

**The land of the free is only as free as we the people allow it to be.** Without that, there is no America Dream, and there is no shining city on the hill.

[**We need solutions, not worries.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=c0688cc325b146de90a9f7e754c93465&_e=115pRe2kQJJSp0LJ_CM_cXGV7D5SrWvc5ZDz4blgebkthquvyhGzebDTL-8pnoO0kQe6YRMsHXO3Ia9n79u0Nx7jrvOlVB-RCL284vz3uXcZez9MvHOXD-thPmIb9BQKaVChdCusGrL5DiLZf6MSg7NoOY7HbbFP7XvwNhH1adi3CmAOnyIFGn5vkO69ga1VEstNr82XgiCG_euAdHl0DPPB8VqMMjY4S1UXQyLbLgyOz_wGiNNuoaM9ASTeGWtH6tIZsl32CUQXLKT6XVmwmv-UkOf8iw5i-vRV0bvbRPINyMt18W0W2N-7CfKxYiU8BbyUq3HafoayYWvxCyUy3AlRHwSuU-5gy1j0mpfG6QmQWv3QUWLyZMZq4sCJBNdBcwpJ7cksNyLo67ll-PWM4siwnK7rNwId38hQjBj_-UtPvVtAbwsoeLvUz9iD-B1EHjk9OBK_bb1mGqZprs7Lzx_8uPv98Yg8ILVdEyzN-Ri_3Osfmg1S3FcpkPSU_gmH) That’s why my husband, James Tarantin, is running to make history by being the first Israeli-Born Senator in the history of our country.

Our family, along with families like yours, truly represent the American Dream. Thank you and God bless, James Tarantin U.S. Senate Candidate (MD) From: Jena Tarantin Sent: Thursday, February 24, 2022 1:07:00 PM To: James Tarantin Subject: Russian War - True Story My Dear Fellow American, My name is Jena Tarantin, you’ve probably heard from my husband, I know you’re busy, but I wanted to reach out because as a mother and a U.S. citizen, I am worried about what we’re seeing in our nation. My parents and I lived during the dark times of the communist Soviet Union. I remember all the restrictions that were imposed on my family and all the liberties that were taken away from us. Despite being so young, I remember those days, and I remember when my parents decided to take me and my sister to America – the land of opportunity. My parents’ brave decision to leave everything behind and pursue the American Dream, allowed me to become a nurse and a mother of two wonderful boys in the land of the free. However, I am truly worried that the dark times my parents escaped from, is the same thing that is slowly coming back again! As Ronald Reagan once said, “If we lose freedom here, there is no place to escape to. This is the last stand on Earth.” He wasn’t wrong, that’s why so much of what we’re seeing these days has me worried. I am worried that career politicians want power and not our best interest. I am worried that many cities support crime as it benefits them politically. I am worried that some cities and states are allowing illegal immigrants to vote. I am worried that inflation is robbing our savings. I am worried that people and their livelihoods are being replaced by robots. I am worried that Iran will gain nuclear weapons and threaten us all. I am worried that politicians want to control our children’s education. I am worried that our children are being mandated to get vaccines. I am worried that our traditional values are vanishing! I am worried that we are experiencing the death of the American Dream. The land of the free is only as free as we the people allow it to be. Without that, there is no America Dream, and there is no shining city on the hill. That’s why my husband, James Tarantin, is running to make history by being the first Israeli-Born Senator in the history of our country. James is a wonderful father, a loving husband, a man of faith, an honorable fighter for traditional values and a successful businessman who legally immigrated to America with no money, no family, and no connections but was still able to build a successful life here. Our family, along with families like yours, truly represent the American Dream. So if you are worried like I am about what we’re seeing in American, Please... if not for me, then for the love of God and our Country. James is not a career politician. America’s future is up to us, let’s work together and leave it better than we found it. Thank you, Jena Tarantin** P.S. I wish to share with you a note my grandfather left for me before he passed away in the Soviet Union: May the American People be with you down every road you roam. And may its compassion surround you when you're far from my wooden home. And may you grow to be conservative, kind and true. And do unto others as you'd have done to you. Be brave my dear child as the fighters in World War Two. And in my heart you'll always stay bright as the Light that comes America’s shores. name: Dr. Bob Lorinser
subject: 🔔 Socialism or Capitalism?
disclaimer_text: paid for by tax levies on property owners
body:
The demonization of social programs has been an absurd scare tactic since the 1870s. It's overused, dishonest, and lazy.

"I am a classic Democrat who prefers competitive Capitalism, which needs to be monitored and regulated to maintain its success." — Dr. Bob Lorinser

HOUGHTON, Mich. — Immediately after the Civil War, the 15th Amendment gave poor Black men the right to vote. They voted for roads, schools, and hospitals paid for by tax levies on property owners. Southern white supremacists called it "Socialism." Affluent Northerners adopted their ideas and language but targeted immigrants and organized workers.

When Woodrow Wilson's Revenue Act of 1913 replaced tariffs with an income tax, opponents cried of this country's "Socialistic downfall." When President Franklin Delano Roosevelt pioneered the New Deal, Republicans saw Socialism.
This tactic is overused, dishonest, and lazy.
Sometimes on the campaign trail, people tell me they haven't voted Democratic in the past because they thought it's terrible for the economy. Yet, the economy has performed better under Democrats than Republicans since World War II. From 1945 on, the S&P 500's annual gain was 11% when Democrats were in control, versus 7% under Republicans. The GDP grew by 4% under Democrats and 2.5% under Republicans. Job growth, too, is significantly more under Democrats than Republicans.

I support Capitalism based on fair competition to make sure everyone wins — not just big business, but everyday citizens of our Nation. Capitalism is not flawless, and it takes government oversight to make sure it is wise, kind, and just for all Americans.

I support:
Our Constitutional Republic, based on liberty and civic virtue — the dedication of citizens to the common well-being of each other.
Accessible and affordable education and universal healthcare.
A government that cares for people with physical and intellectual disabilities to protect human dignity for all.
Workers' rights, unions, collective bargaining, and reasonable regulation of large corporations and polluters.
The prevention of exploitation of all Americans in every sector.
Human rights for all Americans, including the historically oppressed - Women, People of Color, Indigenous and our LGBTQ communities.
These ideals make me a proud American. They're American principles.

CONTRIBUTE

About Dr. Lorinser

For his entire career, Dr. Bob Lorinser (D-MI1) has dedicated his life to the service of his community and country.

After receiving three advanced degrees (Medical Doctor, Masters of Social Work, and Masters in Public Health), Dr. Lorinser worked as a social worker in a Veterans Affairs Hospital and as a physician with the Indian Health Service, serving the Navajo Nation. In 1989, he found his home in Michigan's First District, where he practiced family medicine for three decades.

Dr. Bob joined the U.S. Department of State's Foreign Services in 2011 to serve as a diplomat and Regional Medical Officer. The Lorinsers served the United States for ten years, with tours in Pakistan, South Korea, Afghanistan, Morocco, and Iraq.

When he returned to the states in 2020, Dr. Bob offered his services as Medical Director of Marquette County Health Department. He and his wife of 40 years, Peggy, live in Gwinn and have three children and four granddaughters.

Dr. Bob Lorinser hopes to serve and represent constituents in Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula. He is unopposed in the Democrat primary and poised to face Rep. Jack Bergman (R, Acme) in the general mid-term election this November. I'm confident I can be an influential member of Congress for the First District and guide us on a national and worldwide stage under the ideals and principles of what it means to be a proud American. I genuinely care about every one of you, whether you are a democrat, republican, or independent. If elected, I will strive to be the voice for all district residents. My family, friends, and staff have put everything we have into turning our vision of this great state into a reality, and we will continue to work towards achieving that objective. Every day, we build and strengthen partnerships with voters and citizens alike who align with the vision we want to bring to the United States and Northern Michigan. Many may look at me and see mostly what I have lost. But I was allowed the opportunity for a new life...
#

Friends -
After a gunman shot me in the head more than ten years ago, I lost the ability to speak and walk as easily as I once did. Today, I know many may look at me and see mostly what I’ve lost. But I was allowed the opportunity for a new life. **Instead of focusing on what I cannot do, I have tried to live without limits. I've set tougher and tougher goals for myself.**
Some of those goals I must pursue alone. Others require teamwork and the commitment of many others to accomplish what most believed would be impossible.
Taking on the gun lobby and reducing the number of Americans killed or injured by a gun tragedy is not easy work. Many people in Washington, D.C. would probably tell you that's impossible.
This November, however, we have a historic chance to elect a Congress that will pass bills to prevent some of the 40,000 gun deaths that happen in this country every year and send them to a president who will sign those bills into law.
I believe that’s worth fighting for, but I cannot do it alone:

**God bless and help the United States.** This new poll is evidence that Democrats should not be in positions of power. They’ll bend the knee to any foreign adversary who credibly threatens invasion of our homeland.

My parents came from Haiti without a penny to their name to make a better life for themselves and their family. **Haitians have no freedom: neither economic nor political.** The United States is and WILL remain the last best hope for humanity; she’s worth defending.

**Every single Democrat ought to be defeated in this year’s midterms.**

You’ve seen what’s happened over the past year. Democrats have already brought the country to its knees economically. Let’s reverse course while we still can; **we fail to act at our own peril.**

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

name: Hillsdale College via RightSide ALERTS
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| _Sponsored by Hillsdale College_

| | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a3b5730368584f968aa3dde8d119e93c&_e=houZPRRV7--RqkfQbvUzC9aMfbAwQ8PrXf8Uhj3z_sSgB4RsZkm5sMOQOPtys2L1TESUw9mv3ZXXokO4hQx9bcO4AzA8gA425F2mNTxWuX2zHzbToOc8Qn7sP7BQZZ_JckBlHXgCLWMgk-DgdavaDM5HPTLt-0Or7rVFq3eZ2YgzuLDos9xHDH0F7cuaY804-IxvtgQTSefmMp3ukTyWV2xQlVsgMjuJ1K2_0ECPQX0kn8U86NKR46DYO2XgH6937rGyo7ZbmmLFZwZEZ2g4LBgwX9NQOrHdQIbQ4zi3asQM23URX0_8EF3v_CELuZEtV9Fy2boTMI5T1yvnqdn-yfyOfSq87K6QTorFarpSte1jbSkLO_hmKu3JalCLbtQFdbYtKnrICQHiJUeRfXHu-CXCayhB6F_tb0Z1LcJAKUhwBI2wUVqpJ_1ihwX9i2dS) Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a3b5730368584f968aa3dde8d119e93c&_e=houZPRRV7--RqkfQbvUzC9aMfbAwQ8PrXf8Uhj3z_sSgB4RsZkm5sMOQOPtys2L1TESUw9mv3ZXXokO4hQx9bcO4AzA8gA425F2mNTxWuX2zHzbToOc8Qn7sP7BQZZ_JckBlHXgCLWMgk-DgdavaDM5HPTLt-0Or7rVFq3eZ2YgzuLDos9xHDH0F7cuaY804-IxvtgQTSefmMp3ukTyWV2xQlVsgMjuJ1K2_0ECPQX2gBk1QXxvl6BFvbgem1u0jPCR4lk1KZO74bc4vjTPeX21HkFmHRAa2U2Dn0gchmqBPlZTBioknyh8DtYeOeIs5_gSmT3TnoUQ7_gjSKcFyb_2D9z3GOg1LLrSkZ2rR3OeROVDxNUiaEfJip7gA_bD7QjH0r4I7-buKMkFB6b6gdt1j79nVaksomFnuIhJ2080riQCTe9pGe5DQYdrIUZkT)**

For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching _millions_ of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:

• **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
• **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
• **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
• **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
• **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

**And this is especially important in 2020, a critical year for America’s future.**

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using the secure link I’ve provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a3b5730368584f968aa3dde8d119e93c&_e=houZPRRV7--RqkfQbvUzC9aMfbAwQ8PrXf8Uhj3z_sSgB4RsZkm5sMOQOPtys2L1TESUw9mv3ZXXokO4hQx9bcO4AzA8gA425F2mNTxWuX2zHzbToOc8Qn7sP7BQZZ_JckBlHXgCLWMgk-DgdavaDM5HPTLt-0Or7rVFq3eZ2YgzuLDos9xHDH0F7cuaY804-IxvtgQTSefmMp3ukTyWV2xQlVsgMjuJ1K2_0ECPQX3Sn3c3oEdBG7237uAZyuPk2mEECji-w8duU95hZoe54nilRE4B4r5uHsW6iHAkuyFVgMUuwjJtYP9Sl6CH04WZybsTfH6MnQgA-EGdzCyIHon1CJ-OAHXNKKyjCcJ7Ifb2HLwBE-HKWx9X4DZKNzjbfnPiJqvOnTYZdW6ddo_zpp1NPBw7M6ZzefWTRWtsXBDrhWAq1uet70jHKPeb6TJf)**

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty. This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include: • Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;” • Reaching over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty; • Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; • Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and • Restoring excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in 2020, a critical year for America’s future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using the secure link I’ve provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 Hillsdale College. All rights reserved. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? .

| All we can say is—Wow!

It rained. The wind blew. The temperature dropped. And still, thousands of Make America Great supporters showed up in Florence last Saturday to hear President Donald Trump. Wet weather and chilly temperatures weren’t enough to keep these patriots from showing up.

Russell Fry was grateful for the 45th President’s enthusiastic endorsement and the strong outpouring of support from hundreds of backers right here in the Grand Strand and Pee Dee. With the growing number of people just like you joining our team every day, we know we can carry Russell Fry’s campaign to victory in the June 14 primary.

Special thanks to the +100 volunteers who didn’t let inclement weather stand in their way! For those of you who couldn’t make it, enjoy these photos from Saturday’s rally.

The campaign is looking for County Coordinators in Granville, Orange, and Durham Counties.

The County Coordinator role consists of the following:
1. Scope out neighborhoods in your county to canvass in

name: Derek Marshall
subject: It's time to tax the rich
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Derek Marshall for Congress
body:
Peter,
It's an unfortunate reality that in the richest country on earth millions of people have to decide every month whether to pay rent or buy the medicine they need to live.
**Think of all the amazing things our country could have, the lives we could live if the rich paid their dues. **Universal healthcare, a Green New Deal, affordable housing, and the return of anti-poverty measures like the Child Tax Credit; it’s all possible if we decide to fund it properly.
Skeptics always ask us progressives: “How are you going to pay for it?!” **The answer is simple, and obvious: it’s time to tax the rich** and invest those same resources right back into our communities, like we should have been doing all along.
[**I’m running as a Democrat AND a progressive. I advocate for smart, popular policies. Unlike my opponent, I believe in a diverse, inclusive, and fair world. If that sounds like the type of person you want in Congress, then I’m asking you to start a small monthly contribution to my campaign. Even $5 helps us out! Will you chip in today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42997120/335251332/1232707546?refcode=3-15&amount=5&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YTU2MWIwMC04ZWE0LWVjMTEtYTIyYS0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vQDeytLGWMM3U0a44hbP7DWwXvsg320zXixUAi3a3tg=)
All around the country, people are forced to choose between housing and medication. We can't keep living like this. **Profits go up while salaries stay the same and cost of living gets higher. We can't keep living like this. **There is $1.7 trillion in student loan debt and millions of Americans face years of constant debt payments. We can't keep living like this.
**Every day the working class pays more than their fair share to live in America with higher tax rates than the richest people on Earth.** It's time they pay their share just like everyone else. Otherwise, runaway wealth inequality will be the downfall of our nation. We need strong, brave leaders to stand up to the uber rich and the money they pour into our political system.
I'm not scared of billionaires like Jeff Bezos, Elon Musk, or Fortune 500 CEO’s. **Why? Because their money doesn't fund my campaign or line my pockets, and it never will.** I always have and always will side with the people.
**[If you support my candidacy to be the next Congressman for California’s 23rd District, then please consider starting a small monthly contribution to my campaign. For just $5 and the price of a daily coffee, you can make a difference for us–can I count on you?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42997124/335251336/1232707546?refcode=3-15&amount=5&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YTU2MWIwMC04ZWE0LWVjMTEtYTIyYS0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vQDeytLGWMM3U0a44hbP7DWwXvsg320zXixUAi3a3tg=)**

In solidarity,
**Derek Marshall**
Candidate for U.S. Congress, CA-23

clean_body: Peter, It's an unfortunate reality that in the richest country on earth millions of people have to decide every month whether to pay rent or buy the medicine they need to live. Think of all the amazing things our country could have, the lives we could live if the rich paid their dues. Universal healthcare, a Green New Deal, affordable housing, and the return of anti-poverty measures like the Child Tax Credit; it’s all possible if we decide to fund it properly. Skeptics always ask us progressives: “How are you going to pay for it?!” The answer is simple, and obvious: it’s time to tax the rich and invest those same resources right back into our communities, like we should have been doing all along. = All around the country, people are forced to choose between housing and medication. We can't keep living like this. Profits go up while salaries stay the same and cost of living gets higher. We can't keep living like this. There is $1.7 trillion in student loan debt and millions of Americans face years of constant debt payments. We can't keep living like this. Every day the working class pays more than their fair share to live in America with higher tax rates than the richest people on Earth. It's time they pay their share just like everyone else. Otherwise, runaway wealth inequality will be the downfall of our nation. We need strong, brave leaders to stand up to the uber rich and the money they pour into our political system. I'm not scared of billionaires like Jeff Bezos, Elon Musk, or Fortune 500 CEO’s. Why? Because their money doesn't fund my campaign or line my pockets, and it never will. I always have and always will side with the people. = In solidarity, Derek Marshall Candidate for U.S. Congress, CA-23 * = Paid for by Derek Marshall for Congress. P.O. | | Dear Peter,

**_We are taking back America, and we’re starting by taking back Georgia._**

After much prayer and consideration, our team has made the decision to pivot to a race where we felt could have a bigger and more immediate impact in the fight to defend our conservative values from the onslaught of the Radical Left. Thankfully, President Trump agreed – and he issued a very generous endorsement of my campaign last week to prove it.

I’m working to become the next Insurance Commissioner here in Georgia.
---
|
---
| [ ](https://patrickwitt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=776ede99b48702dfd47b28eb8&id=537c7d5895&e=d77f98215b)
---
|
---
| Candidates for this office rarely set an ambitious agenda, but my time working in the Trump Administration taught me that we _must_. Opportunities for reform are too rare and fleeting not to do so.

**_If I’m entrusted to serve in this role, here are a few things you can expect in short order_** :
* My office **_will_** block insurance plans that require Georgians to fund abortions, or gender-altering hormone regimens for children;
* My office **_will_ **notify insurance companies that they may not deny Georgians access to healthcare because of their vaccination status;
* My office **_will_** work with the legislature to reduce Georgia’s premium tax–one of the highest in the nation–which would lower healthcare insurance costs by encouraging competition;
* My office **_will_** establish a 24/7 customer service hotline – giving Georgians the opportunity to file a complaint _at any time_ if they are treated improperly by an insurance company.

The battlefield in the fight against the radical agenda of Joe Biden and the Democrat Party is expanding, and we see winning this race as a **_critical_** step in the effort to take Georgia and America back.

[**_You’ve been such a loyal supporter up to this point, and I’m grateful for your continued support as I seek this new office. Would you join President Trump in endorsing my campaign with a generous contribution?_**](https://patrickwitt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=776ede99b48702dfd47b28eb8&id=272b4c60a5&e=d77f98215b)

2022 is an important year for our state and nation as we move towards the elections – and it will be our first real opportunity to vote out those who have **_not_** put Georgia and America first.

I hope to earn your support as we Make America – and Georgia – Great Again.

Best,

Patrick Witt
Republican Candidate, Insurance Commissioner
