> _**Don’t Miss the Boat!**
>
> Get onboard the ship to victory with Ed Thelander, candidate for Maine's 1st Congressional District, at DiMillo’s on the Water in Portland.
> Saturday, March 26th ~ 5:00-6:00 ~ Sponsors Hour
> 6:00-8:00 ~ Ticket holders
>
> Special Guests include Yasin Ahmady, a.k.a. General Joe Gomez, Afghan Freedom Fighter during the Russian invasion of his homeland, and interpreter for SEAL Teams and Special Forces during Operation Enduring Freedom Afghanistan.
>
> **\- ALSO - **
>
> Hear remarks by 8th generation Maine lobsterman Jason Joyce. Jason brought the struggles of the Maine lobster industry to the national spotlight when he addressed the Republican National Convention in 2020. Jason will provide an update on state and federal regulations that threaten the lobstering way of life, and the ongoing clash with the offshore industrial wind industry. Jason will also show a preview of his son Andrew's excellent documentary, "The Maine Reset", a beautiful yet alarming look at the many threats facing this industry which is so integral to Maine._

subject: Our healthcare system is a disaster.
body:
It pains me to say it, but our country is not healthy. Our health and resilience are our strongest defenses to threats, foreign and domestic. | |
---
| | |
---
| | | **Dear Peter,**

It pains me to say it, but our country is _not_ healthy. Our health and resilience are our strongest defenses to threats, foreign and domestic.

Much of the devastatingly high death tolls and carnage inflicted by COVID-19 were preventable and we need members of Congress that are willing to _lead_ on expanding health care access.
---
| [Support our grassroots campaign today!](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=d361fcb501&e=0faa9de128 "Support our grassroots campaign today!")
---
| I’ve dedicated my career to addressing disasters and the root-causes of problems. Now, I’m running for Congress to take this critical advocacy to the next level. Yes, our country is divided. However, people agree on this:
Health care access is a disaster.

We must address disparities across our district and we can’t continue to kick the can down the road.

That’s why I support a Medicare _option_ for all. Let’s _at least_ lower the Medicare age by 5 or 10 years. There is bipartisan support for expanding Medicare access. Just look at the latest bipartisan bill reforming the U.S. Postal Service.

I want to _increase_ access, not reduce or take it away. Let’s give everyone the _option_ to access health care. If you like your own plan, you’re lucky and let’s not mess with that.
* We need to organize in the rural and urban communities most impacted by these disparities. We need to improve our data collection nationwide so we can more easily pinpoint racial and socioeconomic disparities and address them.
* We need to _incentivize_ more healthcare providers to provide services in rural and urban areas. We can begin by expanding existing Public Service Loan Forgiveness programs to _reward_ practitioners that address critical gaps.
* We need to hold insurance companies _accountable_ and develop rules that prevent them from cutting reimbursement rates to providers. Let’s _incentivize_ mental health providers to take insurance (i.e. reducing student loans payments is one idea).
* We need to hold nursing homes _accountable_ , protect and strengthen disability rights protections, and prioritize independence to prevent the devastating carnage we witnessed during COVID-19.
* We need to hold pharmaceutical companies _accountable_ and allow Medicare to negotiate drug prices to save taxpayer and consumer dollars.
* We need to pass campaign finance reforms to reduce the power of special interests in Washington. Our health needs to come first. Not big business.
* We need to invest in a healthier society and we need the leadership in Congress to _get it done_.

Let’s take a stand against conflicts of interest and flip this seat from big business to public interest. I can’t win without your support. Take action by supporting our grassroots campaign below!
\-- Ben Smilowitz, Democrat for Congress in Maryland's 6th Congressional District

I was so proud to stand alongside advocates, health professionals, and fellow Democrats in the Colorado House of Representatives to pass the Reproductive Health Equity Act. This bill enshrines the right to reproductive freedom for Coloradans into law.
**It’s that simple. The Reproductive Health Equity Act (RHEA) is the template for how Congress should codify _Roe v. Wade_ and protect every American’s freedom to choose.**
Have you ever told a 14 year-old that her chronic stomach ache is actually a pregnancy? I have, and as her pediatrician, I was able to give her a choice in that moment — to become a mom, or not. I cannot _imagine_ telling any patient of mine that she has no freedom to make that choice for herself.
Republicans in the House tried to stop us by holding up passage on the floor for more than 24 hours — but we weren’t backing down, because we all know how important this is. Now, we have to take the fight to Washington, because the Supreme Court is stacked with far-right justices who will seek any excuse to overturn the Roe decision.
And my anti-choice GOP opponents are right there with them. **One of them, Barbara Kirkmeyer, called RHEA “the most extreme, barbaric, radical abortion law in our nation.”**

This week, I voted in the state legislature to protect choice and make abortion safe and accessible for Coloradans — and I can't wait to vote to protect reproductive freedom for every American when in Congress. = | = I was so proud to stand alongside advocates, health professionals, and fellow Democrats in the Colorado House of Representatives to pass the Reproductive Health Equity Act. This bill enshrines the right to reproductive freedom for Coloradans into law. It’s that simple. The Reproductive Health Equity Act (RHEA) is the template for how Congress should codify Roe v. Wade and protect every American’s freedom to choose. Have you ever told a 14 year-old that her chronic stomach ache is actually a pregnancy? I have, and as her pediatrician, I was able to give her a choice in that moment — to become a mom, or not. I cannot imagine telling any patient of mine that she has no freedom to make that choice for herself. Republicans in the House tried to stop us by holding up passage on the floor for more than 24 hours — but we weren’t backing down, because we all know how important this is. Now, we have to take the fight to Washington, because the Supreme Court is stacked with far-right justices who will seek any excuse to overturn the Roe decision. And my anti-choice GOP opponents are right there with them. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, will you
chip in $20.29 to help us reach our critical mid-month goal by tomorrow
midnight?

(Keep reading and we’ll tell you why this amount!)

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220315?refcode=em20220315-1653&amounts=20.29&t=1001&refcode2=1653_346206_02zpo5&akid=1653%2E346206%2E02zpo5 ]CHIP IN $20.29 →

We’re proud that on average, Peter,
our online donation is $20.29.

That might not seem like a lot, but there’s a lot of power in that number.

This number represents the grassroots movement we’re building right here
in Kentucky: teachers, fast food workers, coal miners, nurses, students,
and believers in change are coming together and chipping in whatever they
can to help defeat Rand Paul and elect Charles.

That’s powerful,
Peter. If we keep fighting like
this — putting our $5, $10, $20.29 donations together — we’re confident we
can finally hold Rand Paul accountable for his corruption and lies. We’re
confident that we can replace him with a leader who will actually fight
for us.

Charles knows what it’s like to struggle to make ends meet, to choose
between affording medication and groceries, to lose loved ones to gun
violence. He’s determined to put the challenges and issues everyday people
in Kentucky face at the center of our campaign, but we’re relying on
supporters like you to power this work.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220315?refcode=em20220315-1653&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&refcode2=1653_346206_02zpo5&akid=1653%2E346206%2E02zpo5 ]Will you chip in $20.29 or anything you can to help make sure our
campaign hits our critical $13,000 mid-month fundraising goal during our
first end-of-quarter month? We’re just a little over $8,700 away:

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220315?refcode=em20220315-1653&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&refcode2=1653_346206_02zpo5&akid=1653%2E346206%2E02zpo5 ]DONATE NOW →

$20.29 may not be a lot compared to the average donations of other
campaigns — but that’s what sets us apart.

We’re creating a movement unique to Kentucky that represents the many and
not the few. That’s why we don’t accept a single cent from special
interests or corporations.

We believe this kind of strategy is our strongest chance to mobilize
voters from the hood to the holler, defeat Rand Paul, and expand our
majority in the Senate so we can finally pass the urgent policies we need.

But it also means we’re really relying on grassroots supporters like you
to help out as we prepare to take on Rand Paul’s war chest of corporate
money.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220315?refcode=em20220315-1653&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&refcode2=1653_346206_02zpo5&akid=1653%2E346206%2E02zpo5 ]Please give $20.29 or anything you can today to help us hit our goal.
We only have one more day until the deadline, so any amount you can give
makes a big difference towards reaching our goal.

Together,

Team Booker

body:
| | | Team, **We just got some BIG news! Maryland just moved our primary election to JULY 19.** That's an extra THREE WEEKS of campaigning we need to fund. We're launching an Emergency Primary Extension Fund to make sure we have the resources we need. Every day, we're knocking doors, handing out literature and putting yard signs around the district. body:

Today is Equal Pay Day, which marks how far into the new year a woman must work in order to be paid what a man was paid the previous year. In 2022, this means women are paid 83 cents for every dollar paid to men , and the earlier Equal Pay Day arrives, the closer we are to closing the gender wage gap.
However, as we strive to close the gender wage gap, the disparities are even greater for women of color . When we fight to close the gender wage gap, we need to fight for closing the racial wage gap.
When women aren’t fairly compensated for their work, it has a significant impact on our community. But it goes deeper than just a few cents. Women are also more likely faced with the risk of being pushed out of the workforce or demoted without these rights. In order to achieve gender wage equity, women need access to the necessary resources that will help us thrive like paid leave, support for caregivers, and affordable childcare.
If elected, I will fight to stop the cycle where women are locked into lower wages.
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/91626/images/VV22%20graphics%20-%20Welcome%20%282%29.png]
So I hope you will join us in recognizing Equal Pay Day and the push for closing the gender and racial wage gap.

_**“I never thought I’d live to see the day half of Democrats would toss the whole country to the wolves if given the chance.”**
- Matthew Hennessey_
Fellow Conservative,

Did you see the Quinnipiac Poll that came out this week? If you didn’t read the headlines, **you’ll want to continue reading this email.**

The polling firm found that when asked _**“What would you do if you were in the same position as Ukrainians are now, stay and fight or leave the country?”**_

| | **I just tested positive for COVID.** Thankfully, contact tracing warned me that a contact was positive. Thankfully, I have rapid home tests. Thankfully, I had no wait for a PCR test at the pharmacy. Thankfully, I am vaccinated. Thankfully, my sweet son slipped a get-well card under the door: I caught COVID on the second anniversary of the pandemic. **Yes, I feel miserable. I woke up in the middle of the night with a fever, but I'm not scared like I would have been a year or two ago**. That doesn't mean I'm not worried. I have elderly family members and four year old who is still not vaccinated that I pray will not get sick I'm not scared now, but I was two years ago. This time in 2020, a colleague I had just spent time with tested positive. He is a healthy man in his 40s who still had to go on a ventilator in a hospital. Because of my exposure, I was quarantined in March 2020 as panic gripped our nation. It was near impossible to get a test. I still remember the discomfort of the first nasal swab. It took over six days for results. Vaccines were just a hopeful dream. I was terrified because I was with elderly family and little kids and couldn't bear it if they got sick, especially from me. I was also fearful that the economy was about to bottom out. Stock market dropping thousands a day. People were talking about not just a recession but a possible depression. It felt like the world was falling apart around us. **I think it's important to keep some reflection on the last two years.** **We've been through a lot.** We have a lot of resilience. None of us had ever been through anything like this before. We had to be more adaptive than probably any other time in our lives. But it also came at a great cost. Sometime in the next few weeks, we will hit 1 million killed in our country. **1 in 330 Americans have died of COVID.** That ratio holds true in Congress. Of 435 members and 100 senators, two have died. 1 in 267 congressional members have died of COVID. In my congressional district, it's worse. 1 in about 200 of my neighbors and constituents died of COVID. I'll never be able to grapple with that staggering scale of loss fully. **Let us not be numb to the tragedy. We can move forward while still honoring those we lost.** **I keep saying the opposite of democracy is apathy. We are not helpless. As I look at this positive test, I am not scared, nor do I feel helpless** because many Americans stared down this pandemic over the last two years and worked hard together to solve problems and get tools and treatments. I'm glad I had some tools at home when I woke up with a fever**. I recommend everyone have rapid tests at home. They were critical for me and in tracking my family's health to see if I had exposed them.** [**Get free tests sent to your door now (it literally takes 10 seconds to fill out): COVIDtests.gov**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43007547/335281900/-2091205112?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzRiZDEyNi1hOWE0LWVjMTEtYTIyYS0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B8gIbRCmGd0kvsvMdc7Ou9vSY2i4SRe3gDT3GNo2NQI=&emci=271a43a7-a4a4-ec11-a22a-281878b85110&emdi=334bd126-a9a4-ec11-a22a-281878b85110&ceid=26261389) _Andy_ |

clean_body: | | | I just tested positive for COVID. Thankfully, contact tracing warned me that a contact was positive. Thankfully, I have rapid home tests. Thankfully, I had no wait for a PCR test at the pharmacy. Thankfully, I am vaccinated. Thankfully, my sweet son slipped a get-well card under the door: I caught COVID on the second anniversary of the pandemic. Yes, I feel miserable. I woke up in the middle of the night with a fever, but I'm not scared like I would have been a year or two ago. That doesn't mean I'm not worried. I have elderly family members and four year old who is still not vaccinated that I pray will not get sick I'm not scared now, but I was two years ago. This time in 2020, a colleague I had just spent time with tested positive. He is a healthy man in his 40s who still had to go on a ventilator in a hospital. Because of my exposure, I was quarantined in March 2020 as panic gripped our nation. It was near impossible to get a test. I still remember the discomfort of the first nasal swab. It took over six days for results. Vaccines were just a hopeful dream. I was terrified because I was with elderly family and little kids and couldn't bear it if they got sick, especially from me. I was also fearful that the economy was about to bottom out. Stock market dropping thousands a day. People were talking about not just a recession but a possible depression. It felt like the world was falling apart around us. I think it's important to keep some reflection on the last two years. We've been through a lot. We have a lot of resilience. None of us had ever been through anything like this before. We had to be more adaptive than probably any other time in our lives. But it also came at a great cost. Sometime in the next few weeks, we will hit 1 million killed in our country. 1 in 330 Americans have died of COVID. That ratio holds true in Congress. Of 435 members and 100 senators, two have died. 1 in 267 congressional members have died of COVID. In my congressional district, it's worse. 1 in about 200 of my neighbors and constituents died of COVID. I'll never be able to grapple with that staggering scale of loss fully. Let us not be numb to the tragedy. We can move forward while still honoring those we lost. I keep saying the opposite of democracy is apathy. We are not helpless. As I look at this positive test, I am not scared, nor do I feel helpless because many Americans stared down this pandemic over the last two years and worked hard together to solve problems and get tools and treatments. I'm glad I had some tools at home when I woke up with a fever. I recommend everyone have rapid tests at home. They were critical for me and in tracking my family's health to see if I had exposed them. body:
| [](http://www.schimpf4illinois.com/?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=1)
---
Friend, We hope this email finds you well. Two Mondays ago, we filed our petitions to be on the ballot for Illinois Governor and Lieutenant Governor. Thanks to your hard work, we were able to file the maximum amount allowed (6,500 signatures). Since we were in line at 8AM on Monday morning, we have a chance to have our names listed first on the ballot.
The other campaigns are reviewing our signatures, but we don't expect to face a petition challenge (knock-on-wood). Because we had gathered well over our maximum amount, we were able to review our petition sheets and only turn-in the pages that we believed contained 10 valid signatures. Other governor campaigns were not as detail-oriented and you may very well see some petition challenges in the coming weeks.
The campaign "pre-season" is officially over. We now know who is on the ballot. If you've made your choice for Illinois Governor, now is the time to start helping that team.
Yes, Illinois is a "Blue State," and you need cross-over votes to win. But cross-over votes without the full support of the Republican base results in a blowout (see Mark Kirk 2016). Carolyn and I are the team that can unite the Republican Party AND get the cross -over votes to send JB Pritzker back to his true calling as a bathroom remodeler. But we need your help. Please consider donating to help Carolyn and I win the upcoming primary!
| [](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/donate?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=2 "Help Paul and Carolyn") [Help Paul and Carolyn](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/donate?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=2)
---
* * *
**Volunteer of the Week**
Our volunteer of the week is our Madison County Director, Doug Dial. Doug worked on Paul's 2014 Illinois Attorney General campaign and has been a friend ever since. He was one of many volunteers who gathered over five sheets of petition signatures for us!

Thank you, Doug, for your hard work--and more importantly--your friendship!
[If you'd like to volunteer on our campaign, click here.](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/volunteer?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=3)
* * *
**Media Spotlight**
I did so many interviews in the aftermath of our petition filing that I lost my voice. My long radio interview with Robin Johnson of WVIK was the last one before my voice almost completely disappeared. You can listen to the interview by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=7dhsi8ebVFR5NNvTdNmNNRLGOLeZlfpYyRCaxkb06wBfjlCqvEBeSEiaPAhXBcNOQmMPwCZYa3xp7nEVLUZceTxHqsxxhZpbH99XQQx-3GMC98_JKKnl1vKvE6hNwPXsgm_09yHCz6j1Lixap6NAVxiM_DAlpXdqJAWtxQaYFgfvLacsrxjme_C09TR9zJCp7Zq_nQZ7MaeIdNj0_mOXCtXBozJP7PFOmW_otr6iFrs&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=4).

If you can't handle questions from the media, you aren't going to have the credibility to develop the solutions necessary to unite our state. We post many of our interview on the campaign website. You can listen to those media interviews by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/press?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=5). The picture below is of me at the conclusion of taking questions from the Belleville News-Democrat for over an hour.
[](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6tVgirLU9XjeyDlXT2NtRv9aKztbX_-_I_c_F8kqjFqAz368Ey5A_-7AOWQV-kh7VoNxueGLQp93P6X9AgSKQzw&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=6)[
](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/army_navy_game_watch_party?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_3_15_2022&n=7)
* * *
**Get Involved**
Now that we have the petition process behind us, the focus returns to holding events and spreading our message of "Commonsense Conservative Leadership We Can Trust." If you'd like to help organize one of our "Appetizers & Answers" events (either in your home or at a local restaurant) you can either volunteer on our website or send an email to events@schimpf4illinois.org.
Thanks for reading and Semper Fidelis,
Paul

Peter,
This November, Democrats and Republicans are promising to fight for two entirely different sets of priorities.

But now, Senate Republicans are campaigning on an entirely different platform: raising taxes on tens of millions of American workers, retirees, and seniors.
**[We cannot allow Republicans to take control of the Senate. We set a flash 48-hour mid-month fundraising goal of $4,500 to stay on track to defend the Senate in November. That's how many votes Andy won the governor's office by in 2019. Peter,

Andy has been working hard as governor to create good-paying jobs, ease the economic burden on families, increase resources for our public schools, and keep our communities safe during the COVID-19 pandemic. We've made great strides in the last two years – but we can't forget how close Andy's election was.

**5,136. That's how many votes Andy won the governor's office by in 2019.**

We knocked on more than one million doors and spoke with thousands of Kentuckians. The race was hard, it was expensive, but ultimately it was successful because of your support. And because of it, we've made huge progress for our commonwealth in the last two years. But now, we're facing a tough re-election, and we're gearing up to do it all over again.

We know this is going to be one of the most important governor's races in the entire country in 2023, and Republicans will do whatever it takes to win back this seat and undo the progress we've worked so hard to make. It's only a matter of time before outside money floods Kentucky again to try to defeat Andy.

| | | Hey there,

**In case you missed it, the 5th district has changed a bit with Gov. Tony Evers’ new congressional maps.** The bad news is that the new district will be an even greater challenge to flip — but I’ve never shied away from a challenge and I don’t intend to start now!

**We also received some excellent news that we’re now the only Democratic candidate in the race!**

While some may view these maps as a surefire win for Scott Fitzgerald, I firmly believe the people of Wisconsin are tired of the cult-like behavior by the GOP, and are ready to elect a Congressman who will work for them, regardless of whether they have an “R” or “D” next to their name on the ballot.

[**If you are tired of the extreme partisan politics in Washington, I hope you’ll join me as I work to #FlipThe5th by going head-to-head with Fitzgerald this fall with a recurring contribution of $5 a month.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=3e0232c873&e=356c0699dd)

Mike

| | Dear Peter, **** We originally expected to focus our message today on a long overdue congressional hearing that had been scheduled for tomorrow. It was poised to explore insider trading, and reform proposals to restrict Members of Congress and protect the public from their conflicts of interest. Unfortunately, committee chair Rep. Zoe Lofgren (D-CA) was recently diagnosed with COVID, forcing a delay in the hearing schedule. We wish Rep. Lofgren a speedy and comfortable recovery. As it happens, we have another hearing on which we’re also focused this week. It remains on track for this Thursday, St. Patrick’s Day, March 17. name: Laura Loomer
subject: It’s all smoke and mirrors
body:
While my campaign volunteers and I have been going to every event that we can find to collect signatures and talk to voters face-to-face . . . what did Do-Nothing Dan do?
| | | [](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ky8ikwnb0Vsm94qWv2W892Pg/yUjvM1ZjfejP763HMsKkQwnw)
Patriot,

[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ky8ikwnb0Vsm94qWv2W892Pg/yUjvM1ZjfejP763HMsKkQwnw)My RINO opponent, Do-Nothing Daniel Webster recently patted himself on the back over Facebook and Twitter for collecting enough signatures to get on the ballot for the upcoming Republican primary.

Good for him . . . if it was real!

But, like most things with politicians, it's all smoke and mirrors.

While my campaign volunteers and I have been going to every event that we can find to collect signatures and talk to voters face-to-face . . . what did Do-Nothing Dan do?

Well, he earned his nickname for a reason.

He had a company mail out four petitions per household with a mailer inside an envelope that included another return envelope with paid postage.

How do I know this, well I have a copy of one of his mailers with return postage on my kitchen table right now. I saved it, because as an investigative journalist, when I first saw this back in December, I had a funny feeling that Daniel Webster would try to claim he collected his petitions via grassroots support. This couldn't be further from the truth.

That's just not the way this is supposed to work. But when you're backed by Kevin McCarthy's Political Action Committee, you don't really care about playing fair . . . and you really don't care about talking to voters!

It's important to me that I get a chance to look each voter in the eye and not just tell them who I am, but to listen to them and their concerns.

And the stories I've heard have me wanting to serve in Congress more than ever.

[But, I need your help to get there.](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ky8ikwnb0Vsm94qWv2W892Pg/yUjvM1ZjfejP763HMsKkQwnw)

I'm sure you've filled up your tank recently, so you have an idea of what our campaign is paying just in gas as we drive around the district getting our petitions signed and speaking to voters.

Coupled with ongoing shortages of paper products that we need for door hangers, signs and palm cards, thanks to Biden's supply chain crisis, we're having to pay more than expected.

If you're able, [would you help offset our costs and help me place early orders for our campaign materials so we don't fall short?](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ky8ikwnb0Vsm94qWv2W892Pg/yUjvM1ZjfejP763HMsKkQwnw)

I'm winning this election with boots on the ground - talking to voters - not hiding from them like my RINO opponent does.

When I qualify to be on the ballot via petition, I will actually be able to say that I spoke to every one of those 2,568 voters. Do-Nothing Dan won't be able to say the same!

[So, every dollar you can donate helps us put another boot on the ground!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/ky8ikwnb0Vsm94qWv2W892Pg/yUjvM1ZjfejP763HMsKkQwnw)

Thanks so much for all that you do.

Respectfully,

Laura Loomer

| Peter,

It’s Emily, Josh Riley’s Finance Director.

In just two weeks, our campaign is facing our _final_ quarterly fundraising deadline before Election Day.

| | Dear Friend,
#
The reckless elites in our government are driving our nation right into catastrophe.
With warmongering politicians and inept bureaucrats in charge, the American people, and our great nation, are being put in **grave and existential danger.**

While Biden, Pelosi and the DC establishment dismantle our country domestically, so too are they destroying our national and economic security. As I have said many times before, if we stay on this road, there are only two outcomes: a disastrous, deadly World War with Russia, or the rise of China as the global superpower.

**But it doesn’t just stop at Biden and the Democrats** –the establishment RINOs of the Republican party are complicit as well. That’s why I’m running to unseat Jaime Herrera Beutler. Not only does she not have the interests of Americans in mind, but she also is willing to **sacrifice the people of our country** , and **sacrifice our nation.**

The American people don’t want our children dying for another country’s border–especially one we have no interest intervening with. The American people don’t want to be at the mercy of the Chinese Communist Party. Most importantly, **the American people shouldn’t have to choose between the two.**

Swamp creatures like Jaime Herrera Beutler have deep pockets–or rather, pockets lined with corrupt cash from special interest groups. **That’s why I need your help.** If we are going to defeat the establishment, we need all hands on deck. _If the**people pitch in** , we can defeat Beutler’s **big money donors** and prove we won’t stop until she’s **out of office. **_[_**Donate any amount today and join the fight to save our great nation >>>**_](https://joekentforcongress.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=520f0c556a8895811473126aa&id=e74d1b93aa&e=00856e661d)

body:
Dr. Oz is continuing to dump millions into TV ads in PA.
#
Derek, we want to make sure you saw this shocking news:
**We’re still two months from the primary, yet our Republican opponent Dr. Oz has spent more on TV ads than any other Senate candidate in the entire country.** With a reported net worth of $100 million, Oz can spend virtually unlimited sums to keep Pennsylvania red -- and that’s what he seems to be doing. 🔴
**This is a pivotal moment for our campaign, Derek.** Our team *truly* believes that how we respond to this could make or break us. We’ve got two options:
1\. We either stand by while this celeb pseudoscientist buys his way into the U.S. Senate -- where he’ll have an even bigger stage to push right-wing policies, COVID conspiracies, and falsehoods.
**-- OR --**
2\. We raise up a grassroots army so freaking big that we can match him dollar-for-dollar, flip PA blue, and send a true Pennsylvania fighter for working people to the Senate.
[**_What do you say, Derek? Can we get you to donate $5 now to help us reach our mid-month fundraising goal by midnight tonight so we can fight back against this TV ad onslaught from Dr. Oz?_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/45344?refcode=em20220315-4983&amount=5&t=1&akid=4983%2E434096%2E3AxJq7)
**[Fight Back: Donate $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/45344?refcode=em20220315-4983&amount=5&t=2&akid=4983%2E434096%2E3AxJq7)**
If you flip through the channels anywhere in PA, you’ll see for yourself -- Dr. Oz is using his money and fame to drown our state in TV ads. He’s a serious threat to win not only the Republican nomination, but the whole damn thing.
But if you need a reminder of how important it is we are able to beat Dr. Oz in November, here’s what you absolutely must know:
❌ Dr. Oz is a Republican multi-millionaire who is 100% ready to self-fund this race with unlimited cash -- he even started his campaign with a reported multi-million dollar ad buy.
❌ He’s a longtime resident of New Jersey -- NOT Pennsylvania.
❌ He’s one of Donald Trump’s favorite doctors and a Trump administration appointee.
❌ He loves to push deadly disinformation about COVID-19 + and highlight vaccine deniers on his TV show.
**That’s why it’s critical that we raise as much money as possible by midnight to defeat Dr. Oz and fight back.**
The good news is we have been preparing for this. We have -- by far -- the biggest grassroots campaign in the state. And if we all come together right now, we can out-fundraise, out-organize, and out-campaign Dr. Oz just by the sheer force of our numbers. That’s why we're asking you right now...
**[Please make a $5 donation to help us fight Dr. Oz’s TV ad onslaught. Whether you can give $5 or $50 or $500, it doesn’t matter. What’s important is that, together with your help, we meet our mid-month fundraising goal by midnight tonight.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/45344?refcode=em20220315-4983&amount=5&t=3&akid=4983%2E434096%2E3AxJq7)**
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/45344?refcode=em20220315-4983&amount=5&t=22&akid=4983%2E434096%2E3AxJq7)**
Oz and his millions are a big threat. But he’s no match for our movement. 💪💪💪
Let’s win this thing,
Fetterman for Senate

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220315-4983-footer&t=23&refcode2=4983_434096_3AxJq7&akid=4983%2E434096%2E3AxJq7)**

Where we stand with hours to go.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220315-797-footer-ak&t=2&akid=797%2E90090%2ENMknc4)
**Our mid-month fundraising deadline is in just hours, and we’re behind where we need to be.**
This deadline is critically important. With less than 50 days to go to our primary election, we have to start running get out the vote advertisements everywhere we can to deliver Morgan’s message to undecided voters across the state. But, we won’t be able to do that and expand our reach without your grassroots support.
[That’s why we’re reaching out to ask: Can you rush a contribution of any amount before our midnight deadline?](https://act.morganharper.org/go/29555?refcode=em20220315-797&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=797%2E90090%2ENMknc4)

Once we catch up on our mid-month fundraising, we’ll be able to green light the next set of ads for our campaign. **If we’re unable to catch up, we might have to scale back our advertising budget.** And since we’re 100% grassroots-funded, whatever you chip in today will make a big difference.
Unlike our opponents, Morgan isn’t calling up corporate PACs to fund our advertisements, period. clean_body: | | | I have been endorsed by the 38th Legislative District Democrats. Organizations like these are the backbone of the Democratic Party's grassroots movement across the country. This is the first local party endorsement I have received this election cycle. Even more humbling is the fact that the 38th legislative district is my home district. I am proud that voters in my own backyard recognize my work for them. I am truly honored to have their support. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines this election. Democrats need to get started now if we are going to stop Republicans from taking over the House in November. = My team and I are hard at work to build a grassroots campaign focused on delivering results for the people of Northwest Washington and this endorsement shows our early success. I welcome all of you to join our people powered team and help us defeat our Republican opponent this fall. = While here at Team Larsen we are focused on building a grassroots team ready to do the hard work in the field, the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC) announced that their digital fundraising has "skyrocketed." The NRCC raised $140 million in 2021– just from digital donors. They started this year with $78.2 million in cash on hand. We cannot sit out this election.
